_source: Casa Monarch ground floor: entrance hall with the stair, open living/dining/kitchen facing the garden (south), guest WC and the Gallery (the tutorial room) in the north-west. Fictional house, all dimensions by design.

exterior_walls._comment: West and east walls run between the south and north walls so corners are not modelled twice.

interior_walls._comment: Interior walls stop at the underside of the upper slab (2.65) instead of running through it.

windows_abs._comment: Living room glazing towards the garden.

furniture._comment: Exhibit 1: authored as boxes. Five shelves on 2 cm panels; the bbox rule in data/rules/gallery.json pins its size.

props.Product: Bookshelf authored as JSON boxes, anthracite carcass with oak shelves

gallery.Title: 1  Boxes in JSON
gallery.HowTo: A furniture entry with parts[].boxes: carcass and shelves as absolute metre boxes, one IFC element, two colours. The Dimensions prop is checked against the geometry on every build; data/rules/gallery.json pins the size.
gallery.Prompt: Add a 0.8 x 0.4 x 2.0 m bookshelf with five shelves on the north wall of the study

furniture._comment: Exhibit 3 plinth (procedural sculpture).

gallery.Title: 3  Procedural mesh (Python)
gallery.HowTo: Curved shapes the primitives cannot express are generated as OBJ by a Python function and referenced with {mesh, at, rotation_z, scale}. Regenerate with uv run python src/gen_assets.py.
gallery.Prompt: Generate a 0.5 m tall spiral vase with src/gen_assets.py and put it on the sideboard in the living room

furniture._comment: Exhibit 4 plinth (Poly Haven bust).
Exhibit 4: face turned to the room (south).

props.MeshNote: Face looks toward +Y. Gallery exhibit "Imported from Poly Haven".

gallery.Title: 4  Imported mesh, Poly Haven (CC0)
gallery.Provenance: Marble Bust 01 by Rico Cilliers, polyhaven.com/a/marble_bust_01
gallery.HowTo: Found with uv run python src/find_asset.py "bust", converted with src/convert_asset.py (headless Blender) to metres, Z up, origin centre. The licence travels in the IFC props: MeshSource, MeshLicense, MeshURL, MeshAuthor.
gallery.Prompt: Find a CC0 vase on Poly Haven and place it on the dining table

furniture._comment: Exhibit 5 plinth (Sketchfab teapot).
Exhibit 5: CC-BY, attribution in props and on the plaque.

props.Product: Old Soviet teapot (white enamel kettle with bail handle)
props.Attribution: This work is based on "Old Soviet teapot" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/old-soviet-teapot-9b087673052446299e6decda222a42da) by Amagitsune (https://sketchfab.com/Amagitsune) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
props.MeshNote: Spout points +X, handle stands up. All five source parts kept (body, lid, spout, handle, knob).

gallery.Title: 5  Imported mesh, Sketchfab (CC-BY)
gallery.Provenance: This work is based on "Old Soviet teapot" (https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/old-soviet-teapot-9b087673052446299e6decda222a42da) by Amagitsune (https://sketchfab.com/Amagitsune) licensed under CC-BY-4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
gallery.HowTo: Same pipeline as the Poly Haven bust, plus the attribution the licence requires: on this plaque, in assets/README.md and in the Attribution prop of the element.
gallery.Prompt: Find a CC-BY teapot on Sketchfab, convert it with src/convert_asset.py and credit the author in the props

furniture._comment: Exhibit 6: the print is a textured box 5 mm proud of the frame back; frame 0.90 x 0.62 keeps the 1.449 aspect.

props.Product: Framed print: The Great Wave off Kanagawa (Hokusai, c. 1831), black frame
props.ImageLicense: Public domain (artist died more than 70 years ago; faithful reproduction of a 2D work)

gallery.Title: 6  Image on a surface
gallery.Provenance: The Great Wave off Kanagawa, Katsushika Hokusai, c. 1831; Wikimedia Commons, public domain
gallery.HowTo: A part with texture {image, u_axis, v_axis} projects a JPEG or PNG under assets/ onto its box; the IFC stores real UV coordinates. The frame is one plain box behind it.
gallery.Prompt: Hang a 60 x 41 cm print of assets/picture_great_wave.jpg above the bed

gallery.Prompt: Find a CC0 plant on Poly Haven and put it on the empty plinth in the gallery

gallery.Title: 8  Rules on the built geometry
gallery.Provenance: data/rules/gallery.json, rule gallery-walkway-clear (kind: clear); the terracotta strip is FLOOR_GF_WALKWAY_MARK
gallery.HowTo: The strip marks a zone that must stay empty. Rules run on the built IFC after every build. Drag the empty plinth 20 cm south into the strip and ./build.sh fails, naming the element and the overlap.

gallery.Title: 7  Variants
gallery.Provenance: data/variants.json group gallery_centre; data/variants/gallery_centre/bench.json and sculpture.json
gallery.HowTo: A group owns the ids GAL_CENTRE_*. uv run python src/variant.py list shows the variants; load gallery_centre sculpture swaps the entries in the storey JSON and rebuilds; save captures hand edits back into the variant file.
gallery.Prompt: Switch the gallery centre to the sculpture variant
